compatibility_import.strategy: Preserve resolved original values; migrate changed types; evaluate new settings using Cura 5.13.0 definitions

global.machine_start_gcode:
G21 ; Use millimeters
G90 ; Absolute XYZ positioning
M82 ; Absolute extrusion
G1 Z15.0 F300 ;Move the nozzle up 15mm
;Prime the extruder
G92 E0
G1 F200 E3
G92 E0
global.machine_end_gcode:
M104 S0
M140 S0

; Lift before moving toward home
G91 ; Relative positioning
G1 Z5 F300 ; Raise nozzle clearance by 5 mm

G90 ; Restore absolute XYZ positioning
M82 ; Restore absolute extrusion
G1 X0 Y0 F900 ; Move to X = 0, Y = 0 at 15 mm/s

M400 ; Wait for movement to finish
M84 ; Disable motors

placement: Use original STL XY; compensate CuraEngine CLI bed-center offset; resize Z to 0..0.2 mm
